name: Mechanical Jaws (1-2)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-13: A Gilded Test

disable: DC 12 Thievery check (trained) on the jaw mechanism.

items.name: Jaws
items.text:
Trigger A creature walks on the tile.

---

Effect The jaws of the trap snap shut, Striking the triggering creature. The triggering creature is Immobilized until the trap is disabled or a creature succeeds at a Athletics check to Force it Open. A creature who critically fails the check to Force it Open instead tightens the trap, dealing 1d6+3 piercing damage to the immobilized creature.

text: Mechanical jaws bolted to the stone beneath a camouflaged floor tile.
